inputs.text: [excited] It was 6 meters long — [quickly] as long as a road is wide — it takes up the whole street! Standing up, it was 2 meters tall — as tall as a front door! And it weighed 425 kilos — [proud] as heavy as 2 lions.
[curious] And its claw, [gasps] was that huge too?
[confident] [amazed] The biggest of any raptor: about 9 inches. Almost as long as your whole hand and your arm to the elbow.
